unsupported: Norseman Designs West operates from Cody, Wyoming, where it was founded in 1971 by John Gallis.
Before establishing the shop, Gallis spent 14 years as Bloomingdale's chief high-end cabinetmaker in New York.
The business remains family-run, with his son Ian Gallis joining full-time 17 years ago after working alongside his father for two decades.
Clients are primarily high-end residential owners and interior designers seeking authentic Western ranch aesthetics.
Projects span one-off commissions to full ranch furnishings, all tailored to individual rustic style preferences.
